sections.value: SAVE AND EXCEPT as hereinafter expressly admitted, the defendant denies each and every allegation of facts contained in the statement of claim as if they were set out therein and traversed seriatim

value:
Use this information to enhance the draft:
The role is 'Claimant & Defendant', use if not specify.

Statement of defense is usually direct, eg 'The defendant admits paragraph 1,2 and 3 of the statement of claim.', 'The defendant states in response to paragraph 3 of the statement of claim, that...', 'The defendant denies paragraph 4 of the statement of claim.', 'The defendant avers that...'.

Most of the times the last paragraph begins and ends this way, eg 'The defendant states that he is not liable for the claims, as stated in the claimant's statement of claim and prays the court to dismiss the suit as being frivolous and baseless.'.

Other relevant information: {{information}}.

The draft should be within 200-9000 words.

Use today's date, to fill the date section.
